title: "Biomass analysis"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-11-19"
---

```{r, message=FALSE}

rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggExtra)     # ggMarginal, used below but previously not imported
library(RColorBrewer)

md_csv = "predictions.csv"
metadata <- fread(md_csv)
hist(metadata[,conf])
#filter for high confidence detections!
metadata = metadata[conf > 0.90]

metadata[, DRYMASS_MG_PRED := (BF_PRED*ROI_SIZE_MM)^3 ]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED := DRYMASS_MG_PRED^ (1/3)]
metadata[, sqrtAREA_MM := AREA_MM2^(1/2)]


metadata <- metadata %>%
  separate(
    custom_label,
    into = c("ignore", "sample_id", "species", "location", "date"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  select(-ignore)


metadata <- as.data.table(metadata)
metadata[, date := as.POSIXct(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")]
metadata[,year := format(date, "%Y")]
metadata[,day_of_year :=  as.numeric(format(date, "%j"))]
```

## Data overview

``` {r, message=FALSE}


pdf("Rplots.pdf", w=16, h=9)

p <- ggplot(
  metadata[species=="BG"],
  aes(day_of_year, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED)) +
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(density)), geom = "raster",
                    contour = FALSE, n = 200) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      # RdBu reversed, with the darkest blues dropped so low-density areas read
      # pale rather than navy, matching the published panel
      colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))[3:11],
      name = "density") +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(direction = "horizontal",
                                  title.position = "top",
                                  barwidth = 12, barheight = 0.8)) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left") +
   geom_point( alpha=.6) 

ggMarginal(p, margins = "y", size = 2, type = "histogram")


p <- ggplot(
  metadata[species=="PD"],
  aes(day_of_year, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED)) +
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(density)), geom = "raster",
                    contour = FALSE, n = 200) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      # RdBu reversed, with the darkest blues dropped so low-density areas read
      # pale rather than navy, matching the published panel
      colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))[3:11],
      name = "density") +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(direction = "horizontal",
                                  title.position = "top",
                                  barwidth = 12, barheight = 0.8)) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left") +
   geom_point( alpha=.6) 
ggMarginal(p, margins = "y", size = 2, type = "histogram")
  


ggplot(
  metadata,
  aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED)) +
    geom_histogram() +
    facet_grid(species ~ .)

  



dev.off()
```
